title: The city’s eastern reservoir
text: Udai Sagar is associated with Maharana Udai Singh and the damming of the Berach River. It extends Udaipur’s water story beyond the old-city shoreline. Seen alongside Pichola and Fateh Sagar, the reservoir is a reminder that lakes were infrastructure as well as settings for buildings and royal life.
